Power, the critically acclaimed American crime drama television series, features a complex web of characters whose lives intersect in unexpected ways. Blanca is a tough and resourceful cop who is not afraid to bend the rules to get results. She has a reputation for being a no-nonsense detective who will stop at nothing to solve a case.

Blanca's work history is characterized by her dedication to the police force. She has been a detective for many years and has worked on a variety of cases. Her expertise lies in investigations involving drug trafficking and organized crime. She has a keen eye for detail and is adept at piecing together clues to solve complex cases.

Cooper Saxe, on the other hand, is a lawyer who has worked his way up the ranks in the U.S. Attorney's Office. He is played by Shane Johnson and is introduced in the first season of the series. Saxe is a brilliant legal mind who is always looking for ways to further his career. He is ambitious and driven, but his actions are often motivated by his desire for power rather than a sense of justice.

Saxe's work history is characterized by his political maneuvering and ambition. He has worked in various positions within the U.S. Attorney's Office and has developed a reputation for being a shrewd and cunning lawyer. Saxe is always looking for ways to climb the ladder of success and is not afraid to step on anyone who gets in his way.

Throughout the series, Blanca and Saxe's work histories intersect in unexpected ways.
